purpose: Regenerate the exact response-blind Phase-1 manifest and selected_panels metadata from the same authenticated broader phylogatR archive after the original ephemeral Phase-1 files were lost. Regeneration must reproduce the frozen Phase-1 manifest byte-for-byte before any nucleotide identity, pairwise genetic distance, or empirical TTF statistic is opened.

required_method.selection_rule: rerun the unchanged deterministic response-blind Phase-1 code; do not reconstruct selected_panels from partial downstream summaries
required_method.acceptance_rule: the regenerated phase1_manifest.json SHA-256 and phase1_geometry.csv SHA-256 must exactly equal the frozen hashes

claim_boundary: A PASS means only that the exact missing Phase-1 response-blind manifest and selected_panels metadata were deterministically regenerated from the exact original archive. It is not an empirical result and does not itself authorize nucleotide identity opening.
